thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate observed for tenant 'HeliosBank' in eu-west-1 dedicated pool
alex.h: Paging @oncall — 90% 5xx on /v1/generate for HeliosBank; spike started ~04:12 UTC
priya: On it. joining call — starting triage. Any initial signals on model oom vs runtime?
ben: I'm seeing KV cache mismatches and frequent worker restarts on g4dn-dedicated nodes. Logs show repeated OOMs:
ben: ```
2026-03-15T04:12:23Z worker: pid=6421 oom_kill process killed
2026-03-15T04:12:24Z runtime: failed allocate 1.8GB
```
sara.ops: Incident page created: https://incidents.redwood/2045678901 — severity: high. Notifying CSM @morgan-csm and account owner.
morgan-csm: Notified HeliosBank primary on-call; they're seeing request failures and elevated latency on their side. They want mitigation asap, can accept model fallback if we coordinate.
alex.h: Quick ask: Is HeliosBank on a pinned model version for their VPC/dedicated tenant? We need to know if automatic safe-variant fallback is allowed.
ben: They have tenant pin: model=redwood-qa/llama-45b-v2@20260201 (pinned) with 'enforce_pin': true.
priya: If enforce_pin is true we cannot auto-switch. Need explicit override consent from customer or send a temporary safe_variant via a tenant override flow.
alex.h: Can we do a soft-fallback with request-level routing to a quantized safe variant in the same pool? Maybe `llama-45b-v2-int8`?
sara.ops: Pool capacity for dedicated eu-west-1 is degraded; autoscaler failing due to OOMs. If we switch to int8 variant we might reduce memory pressure by ~50%.
ben: I can stage a safe-variant (llama-45b-v2-int8) in the same tenant namespace and route a small percentage. Need CSM consent to lift pin.
morgan-csm: HeliosBank approves a temporary override for immediate mitigation — they requested 10% traffic to safe_variant for 30m, then reevaluate. Sending written confirmation in thread.
morgan-csm: HeliosBank (via email): "We grant Redwood permission to route up to 10% of traffic to compatible safe variants for 30 minutes to stabilize throughput. Notify before changing pins."
alex.h: OK authorized. priya — can you implement canary routing and set fallback policy? Also add fallback alert thresholds.
priya: Will do. Steps:
priya: 1) create tenant override: `tenant_override.create(tenant='heliosbank', variant='llama-45b-v2-int8', pct=10, duration='30m')`
priya: 2) update routing rule with `route_policy: canary` and `fallback: escalate`.
priya: 3) monitor metrics (error_rate, p95_latency, memory) and rollback if errors increase.
ben: Implemented config change, pushing to runtime slot-3. Logs:
ben: ```
[04:25:00] pushing config to runtime slot-3
[04:25:03] applied override for tenant heliosbank -> variant=llama-45b-v2-int8 pct=10 duration=30m
```
incident-bot: [UPDATE] Override applied. Incident page updated. Notifying on-call and CSM.
alex.h: Visualized metrics look promising — error rate down from 92% -> 18% for the canary traffic.
sara.ops: Starting warm-up for safe-variant workers and preloading KV caches for the 10% slice.
ben: Memory pressure reduced on nodes running the int8 variant; restarts stopped on those workers.
morgan-csm: HeliosBank acknowledged improvement. They want explicit rundown after 30m and to consider permanent pin relaxation.
priya: Monitoring p95 and qualitative sample checks. Also running prompt-safety evals on canary responses; no regressions noted so far.
alex.h: Plan: maintain canary 10% for 30m, if stable promote to 30% then schedule a review with HeliosBank for permanent opt-in. Oncall handoff in 30m to @priya.
oncall-roster-bot: @priya is on call now (04:40 UTC) — auto-handoff recorded.
ben: Adding temporary rate-limiting rule to reduce burst load while we stabilize: `tenant_rate_limit(heliosbank, 150 rps)`
sara.ops: FYI: we've opened a ticket to investigate root cause — probably a bad kernel path in compilation that increases memory for this checkpoint. Tagging eng-runtime.
alex.h: eng-runtime, can you prioritize a postmortem? This looks like regression introduced in last runtime change.
eng-runtime: noted. We'll take it — creating task RT-4921.
morgan-csm: Will coordinate customer comms. Adding timeline and mitigation steps to the incident page.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] After 35m, error rates returned to baseline and canary traffic is stable. Override will auto-expire at 05:00 UTC unless extended.
morgan-csm: HeliosBank requests extension for another 30m while they validate. Approve extension.
priya: Extended override +30m. Updated routing to 20% canary temporarily as per request.
ben: Confirming runtime config: variant=llama-45b-v2-int8 pct=20 expiry=05:30 UTC
alex.h: Great work everyone. Follow-ups: 1) eng-runtime root cause RT-4921 2) consider opt-in safe_variant program for dedicated tenants 3) update docs on tenant override flow.
morgan-csm: I'll handle customer-facing postmortem and FAQ.
incident-bot: Incident closed (metadata: duration=2h, severity=high, mitigations=tenant_override_canary).
